item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — Convergence detected: US Trade Policy & Tariffs × Iran-Gulf Military Conflict
item.description: The escalation of the Iran-Gulf military conflict is leading to elevated oil and gas prices, contributing to inflationary pressures. This complicates the Federal Reserve's efforts to manage inflation, which is already being impacted by U.S. trade policies and tariffs.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — New York Fed's Williams highlights domestic impact of tariffs
item.description: New York Fed President John Williams stated that the burden of tariffs falls 'overwhelmingly' on U.S. businesses and consumers. He noted that these tariffs are hindering the Federal Reserve's ability to achieve its 2% inflation target.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] China Economic Growth Targets — China to Announce Economic Targets and Policies at Upcoming Policy Meeting
item.description: Chinese Premier Li Qiang is scheduled to announce economic targets and policies for the upcoming year on Thursday.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran-Gulf Military Conflict — Stock markets and oil prices remain volatile amid Iran conflict fears
item.description: Experts have warned that continued elevated oil and gas prices could lead to increased costs for goods and services. The volatility in stock markets and commodities persists as concerns over the prolonged Iran conflict continue to influence investor sentiment.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] US Trade Policy & Tariffs — US trade court orders tariff refunds, impacting Trump administration
item.description: A trade court has authorized refunds for tariffs that were invalidated by the Supreme Court last month. This decision represents a setback for the Trump administration's trade policy, as it undermines efforts to maintain these tariffs.

item.title: [DEVELOPING] China Economic Growth Targets — China sets lowest economic growth target since 1991
item.description: China has set its lowest economic growth target since 1991. This marks the first time the target has been lowered since it was adjusted to 'around 5%' in 2023.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran-Gulf Military Conflict — Global X suggests increased focus on emerging markets amid Iran conflict
item.description: Global X has indicated that it might be an opportune moment to increase investments in emerging markets.
